en: Vintage propaganda-style postcard showing a young man in a suit holding a staff with the Latvian red‑white‑red flag, with multiple Latvian flags waving behind him. He raises his right arm in a salute. In the background are industrial scenes with cranes, smokestacks and arched bridges. At the bottom, bold text in Latvian highlights the date "15 MAIJS" and a slogan.
